how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three steps, a few minutes, no paperwork.
how.s1d: Answer simple questions about yourself and your family. No Aadhaar, no exact income, no login.
how.s2d: We check every scheme's rules against your answers and show what you qualify for, and what you almost do.
how.s3d: Read the plain-language guide, gather the documents, and apply on the official portal.

about.title: Why Yojana Saathi?
about.body: India has thousands of welfare schemes, but finding the right one often means reading long notices, guessing at eligibility, or paying an agent. Yojana Saathi puts the rules in plain language, checks them for you in seconds, and always sends you to the official portal to apply.
about.p1d: Every scheme explained simply, in English and Hindi.
about.p2d: We never ask for Aadhaar, PAN or your exact income.
about.p3d: Each scheme links to its official page and shows when we last checked it.
